messages:
amy-sales: Heads up — Upshift exec pushed for a decision by EOW. Two blockers: SSO (they need SAML + SCIM) and pricing. Can we get an exec-ready summary?

devon-se: We can support SAML 2.0, SP-initiated and IdP-initiated. Timeline: if they provide IdP metadata + 2 test users we can do an initial test by Thu. Need network allowlist from their side for the test.

raj-eng: Also need to validate SCIM scope — are they ok with limited attributes (email, name, groups) or do they require custom attributes? That affects the security review.

amy-sales: Uploaded the questionnaire and their pricing ask here: https://files.redwood/example/upshift-poc-qa.pdf — they asked for a 25% first-year concession and EU-only processing during pilot.

maria-legal: 25% off requires deal desk + VP signoff for this account tier. Send ARR estimate and contract term. We can fast-track language but need approval path documented.

sam-cs: From Customer Success — Upshift expects the trial to run in EU region. Can we do Dedicated trial for isolation? They want to avoid data flowing to US.

olivia-infra: Dedicated trial is doable. Ops cost estimate ~= $3,200/week (GPU infra + reserved network). We'll need a capacity request and timeline.

amy-sales: Exec escalation requested by customer on the call — they're asking for a commit timeline and point of contact. I'm holding off on pinging execs until we have clear asks and cost.

devon-se: For SSO test, send SAML metadata + at least two test accounts and I'll schedule a 60m slot. I can also enable a feature-flagged SP endpoint to reduce risk while we validate. Example test steps I need:
```
1. Upload IdP metadata to SP
2. Try SP-initiated login with test user
3. Validate attribute mapping for SCIM
4. Confirm group sync for access control
```

stacey-cust: Upshift eng here — we can share metadata today and will answer SCIM attribute questions. ETA: 3pm PDT.

amy-sales: Perfect. I'll collect: metadata, test users, ARR estimate, signed NDA note and drop to legal/ops.

ops-bot: ticket:dedicated-trial created by amy-sales — request #REQ-4532, estimated provisioning 48h (subject to capacity).

maria-legal: I'll review contract language for pilot discount. Please add the ARR and term in this thread so I can route to deal desk.

amy-sales: Next steps (short): 1) Upshift sends IdP metadata + test users (stacey-cust) 2) Raj to scope SCIM attributes/security impact 3) Ops/Olivia to confirm cost & provision timeline 4) Maria to route discount to deal desk. Target: EOW decision.

devon-se: Ack — ping me when files are in channel, I'll book the test slot and bring eng SRE. :thumbsup:
